assets.exception_why: ROSTER-LOOK section 5: class III adds side-gap panels on the Pod and thicker tread caps on the Core, two parts at one draw each, which is the 2-draw class III layer cap (ROSTER-LOOK:250; docs/decisions.tsv 2026-10-10 w13-PD). Baked-bracket bank split (wave 19, MOTION-SPEC row 208): the claw hooks are their own ClawHooks mesh under Pod so the carrier bank tilts them off a wall, one draw more than that cap, so 3 draws (Pod, Core, ClawHooks). Accepted as a documented class III layer exception by the baked-bracket card (MOTION-SPEC row 208, wave 19), coordinator rulings 6348145961, 6348389397 and 6348497831 on #241 (6348497831: the claw hooks must bank); recorded in docs/decisions.tsv beside the w13-PD rows (2026-10-22T18:42).

baked-bracket bank split (wave 19, MOTION-SPEC row 208): the ClawHooks part is its own mesh so the carrier bank tilts it off a wall, which adds a second draw to a layer that w13-PD (docs/decisions.tsv, 2026-10-10T21:29:13) holds to 1; 2 draws (measured 1 to 2 against the base). Documented layer exception, accepted in coordinator ruling 6348855434 on #241 (option a, after correction 6348848322); baked-bracket card (MOTION-SPEC row 208, wave 19), coordinator rulings 6348145961, 6348389397 and 6348497831 on #241; recorded in docs/decisions.tsv beside w13-PD.
